spans.s: छल m.n. 1. Fraud, trick, deception, delusion, छलमत्र न गृह्यते Mrich.ix., Am.
, M.viii.49, Yaj.i.61; 2. plea, pretext, semblance, guise, प्रत्यर्प्य पूजामुपदाछलेन R.vii.30, Bt.i.1, Am.
; (in this sense the word is often used to indicate an उत्प्रेक्षा, R.vi.54, xvi.28); 3. roguery, knavery; 4. wickedness; 5. a fallacy; 6. design, device.
छलय् vt. (denom. pres. छलयति) To deceive, to cheat, बलिं छलयते Git.G.i., द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि Bg.x.36, Am.
छलिक n. A kind of drama, e.g. छलिकं दुष्रयोज्यमुदाहरंति.
छलिन् m. A cheat, a swindler.
छल्लि f. 1. Bark, skin; 2. a spreading creeper; 3. offspring, progeny.
